indicesNarrative: A massive divergence defined the session: mega-cap tech and semiconductor momentum evaporated (QQQ -1.99%, SMH -7.26%), while equal-weight and value-oriented segments held positive territory (RSP +0.54%, DIA +0.79%). Asia had rallied overnight following Huang's return to Nvidia, but European indices softened and US markets rapidly gave up ground as questions over long-term AI hardware spending and regulatory scrutiny resurfaced.
technicalsNarrative: Technicals reflect significant breadth divergence across major indexes. While QQQ and SMH suffer severe short-term breakdown momentum following failed relief pops, RSP and DIA show stabilization near short-term support bands, creating a bifurcated market where momentum entries in tech remain hazardous while defensive pivots offer tight risk.
